definitions.explanation: A strong desire or determination to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧{意欲|いよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To have the motivation to learn.

examples.japanese: {意欲|いよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いて→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{意欲|いよく}⟦{的|てき}に→意欲的：06262_iyokuteki⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。

notes:
{意欲|いよく} describes a strong inner drive or desire to accomplish something. More formal than ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意欲|いよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have motivation
- {意欲|いよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: highly/poorly motivated
- {意欲|いよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have enthusiasm
- {意欲|いよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: motivation wells up
- {意欲|いよく}⟦{的|てき}に→意欲的：06262_iyokuteki⟧: enthusiastically, proactively
- ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧{意欲|いよく}: desire to learn
- ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧{意欲|いよく}: will to work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧: motivation (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{熱意|ねつい}→熱意：05088_netsui⟧: passion, enthusiasm (focuses on intensity)
- ⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧: motive (reason behind an action)
- ⟦{向上心|こうじょうしん}→向上心：11897_koujoushin⟧: ambition to improve oneself

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in educational, workplace, and self-improvement contexts.
